_NAMES = ['name', 'tags', 'testonly', 'deprecation', 'features', 'visibility', 'transitive_configs', 'exec_properties', 'expect_failure', 'toolchains', 'compatible_with', 'restricted_to', 'package_metadata', 'applicable_licenses', 'exec_compatible_with', 'target_compatible_with', '_action_listener', '_config_dependencies', 'aspect_hints', 'exec_group_compatible_with', 'generator_name', 'generator_function', 'generator_location', 'licenses', 'distribs', 'args', 'output_licenses', 'size', 'timeout', 'flaky', 'shard_count', 'local', 'env', 'env_inherit', '_is_executable', '_test_wrapper', '_test_runtime', '_xml_writer', '_test_setup_script', '_xml_generator_script', '_collect_coverage_script', '_coverage_support', '_coverage_report_generator', '_run_under_exec_config', '_run_under_target_config', '_lcov_merger', 'deps']

def _dump(ctx):
    a = ctx.attr
    lines = ["dir=" + repr(sorted(dir(a)))]
    for n in _NAMES:
        if hasattr(a, n):
            v = getattr(a, n)
            lines.append(n + "=" + type(v) + ":" + repr(v))
        else:
            lines.append(n + "=<absent>")
    lines.append("files_dir=" + repr(sorted(dir(ctx.files))))
    lines.append("file_dir=" + repr(sorted(dir(ctx.file))))
    lines.append("files_builtin=" + repr([ctx.files.toolchains, ctx.files.target_compatible_with, ctx.files._config_dependencies, ctx.files._action_listener]))
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"

def _full_impl(ctx):
    out = ctx.actions.declare_file(ctx.label.name + ".txt")
    ctx.actions.write(output = out, content = _dump(ctx))
    return [DefaultInfo(files = depset([out]))]

def _exe_impl(ctx):
    out = ctx.actions.declare_file(ctx.label.name + ".txt")
    ctx.actions.write(output = out, content = _dump(ctx), is_executable = True)
    return [DefaultInfo(files = depset([out]), executable = out)]

full = rule(implementation = _full_impl, attrs = {"deps": attr.label_list(allow_files = True)})
full_bin = rule(implementation = _exe_impl, executable = True, attrs = {"deps": attr.label_list(allow_files = True)})
full_test = rule(implementation = _exe_impl, test = True, attrs = {"deps": attr.label_list(allow_files = True)})

def full_macro(name, **kwargs):
    full(name = name, **kwargs)
